record: Forsvarsbygg official visitor and heritage information
facts: The preserved public site contains the Donjon museum and the Commandant’s Residence.
Three storeys plus cellar and loft, limewash on natural stone, plain elevations with external splayed reveals, and a fully hipped roof covered with Alta slate.
Commandant’s residence and guardhouse are preserved separately from the central keep.
The preserved magazine is a long, freestanding support building east of the inner fortress.
